text:
Anna G: FYI — customer 'AcmeHealth' seeing ~15-25% 502s on hostedapi when streaming large embeddings. Started ~10:12 UTC, spike correlates with their 8kb chunking.
Samir: looking at frontdoor metrics, saw connection reset rate + envoy stats: upstream_rq_5xx jumped from 0.2% -> 18% for frontdoor-midproxy-prod around 10:11-10:14.
Kai L: grabbed a trace: trace_id=trc_7f9d, upstream reset: RST_STREAM, error_code=2. Upstream reported 'connection closed by peer' in logs.
Jules: infra-bot posted alert — https://redwood.tools/alerts/88021 : frontdoor conn reset surge
infra-bot: alert: frontdoor.conn_reset_rate > 10% on frontdoor-midproxy-prod (10:11-10:15)
Anna G: repro steps I ran from my laptop:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -X POST https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -d '{"model":"e16", "input": ["<~8KB payload>>"]}'
```
Samir: when I replayed ~50 QPS with chunked payloads I see identical 502s. Client shows 'upstream reset while streaming'.
Kai L: suspecting h2 flow control/backpressure: many concurrent streams + midproxy queueing -> upstream ephemeral socket close. Check envoy 'connected upstream' and 'tx succeeded' counters.
Jules: quick mitigation — temporary rate-limit AcmeHealth to 5 QPS and switch them to embeddings-dedicated-hosted (lower fanout). Done via tenant routing rule.
Anna G: Can we get a short-term config change? increase envoy upstream_conn_pool_size or raise max_concurrent_streams on frontdoor to 1024 for midproxy-prod.
Samir: I opened infra ticket INF-4729 to test pool size bump. Also rolled out canary config on 2 nodes: reduced 502s from 22% -> 6% on canary. :thumbsup: 
Kai L: logs show keepalive window exhaustion on midproxy to model-hosts, and socket _write_ errors before RST. Posting snippet:
```text
[upstream] write: broken pipe (errno 32)
[envoy] stream reset reason: connection failure, details: write_timeout
```
Jules: long-term: add adaptive ingress backpressure + priority for streaming responses; also evaluate connection multiplex limits per tenant.
Anna G: Support update sent to customer at 10:52 UTC — told them throttling + region fallback. Customer asked for repro steps and trace id (trc_7f9d). They're happy with workaround for now.
Samir: next actions: 1) monitor INF-4729 canary 2) add telemetry to capture per-tenant concurrent streams 3) run load test with chunked payloads to validate change.
Kai L: I've pushed a debug build to collect per-stream window sizes (off by default). Will flip on for canary.
Anna G: thanks team. I'll close the escalation if canary holds for 30m. :eyes: 
Jules: leaving notes in postmortem draft: link to playbook and suggested routing policy tweaks.
infra-bot: deploy finished: canary config applied to 2/2 nodes at 11:08 UTC
Samir: canary holding at 6% 502s for last 20m; will promote after 1h if stable.
Anna G: closing loop with customer, will follow up in support ticket with mitigation + timeline.
